ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows: the horizontal axis is time, and the vertical axis is runoff/discharge/precipitation; the hydrograph peak after urbanization appears earlier and has a larger peak value, while the hydrograph peak before urbanization is later and gentler. This shows that urbanization will reduce infiltration and water storage and increase surface runoff, thereby aggravating urban floods. Among the candidate measures, the one that can increase infiltration and water storage and reduce surface runoff is expanding the urban green space area, so the urban green space area should be expanded.
